text: (a) Recorded in docs/ideas/20261118.md (718efb2), section 'The rheoTool engine on this computer, in a container': both of the person's sentences and what you made outside the repository. On rheotool-8: the root line 'Nothing is developed now for the rheometer or its simulation engine' binds this repository's general machinery, which is not shaped around a testbed. A request to build an agent for rheoTool is served as any request is, and a clone that reads the line should not take the request as overriding a rule. The clone's reading shows the line's wording can mislead a blind clone. Rewording a rule is the person's, so this seat will propose a clarification rather than land one.
